title: hippuris vulgaris var. maritima
intro: Hippuris vulgaris var. maritima, commonly known as sea lavender or marsh rosemary, is a perennial plant species in the family Hippuridaceae. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of sea lavender include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of sea lavender include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
